description_en: Situated east of Nau Śivālaya (PPK1703) in Gaurīghāṭa, this śivālaya showcases a square sanctum topped with a bell-shaped roof, now devoid of its finial. The shrine, facing south, is in a state of deterioration, contrasting with the relatively well-preserved stone archway (toraṇa) marking the sole entrance to the sanctum. This toraṇa is adorned with the central figure of Chepu, a mythical water creature. Regrettably, the primary deity, likely a stone śivaliṅga, is missing, and no traces of any other previously existing statue are evident. Adjacent to the entrance, a small Bhairava mask (PPK1704-001) is embedded in the wall. The stones forming the three-tiered plinths supporting the brick-made sanctum have become dislodged, with some already fallen. Moreover, a statue of NandīPPK1704-002), Śiva's animal mount, has been displaced from its original location in front of the entrance and, as of September 2023, rests on the plinth facing east.Due to the absence of an inscription documenting the temple's construction at the site, details about the year of its establishment and its benefactor remain elusive. The identity of the principal deity also remains undisclosed. Nevertheless, the temple's architectural features suggest probable construction during the Rāṇā period (1846-1951 CE). Local accounts indicate that the temple has faced neglect for decades, and in recent years, an ascetic has sought refuge within the sanctum. The shrine was previously managed by a private trust, but its members have relocated abroad, leading to the cessation of all rituals many decades ago, as reported by a local resident, Pauḍela, male, age 45.
description_ne: संरक्षणको अभावमा जीर्ण रहेको यस राणाकालीन शिवालयको गर्भगृहमा हाल कुनै शिवलिङ्ग वा मूर्ति बाँकी छैन ।यो शिवालय गौरीघाटमा अवस्थित नौ शिवालय (PPK1703) को पूर्वतिर रहेको छ । दक्षिणाभिमुख यस मन्दिरको छाना घण्टाकारको रहेको छ । जीर्ण अवस्थामा रहेको यस मन्दिरको छानामाथि गजूर छैन भने गर्भगृहमा स्थापित शिवलिङ्ग लगायत अन्य कुनै देवदेवीका मूर्ति हाल अस्तित्वमा छैन । तीनतह पेटीमाथि बनाइएको मन्दिरमा एउटा मात्र ढोका रहेको छ । ढुङ्गाले बनेको ढोकामाथि छेपुको आकृति कुँदिएको तोरण रहेको र ढोका छेउ भित्तामा भैरवको मुखाकृति (PPK1704-001) स्थापना गरिएको छ । मन्दिरका पेटीहरू पनि जीर्ण भई ठाउँ-ठाउँमा भत्किएका छन् । नन्दीको मूर्ति (PPK1704-002) लाई पनि अव्यवस्थित तरिकाले पेटिमाथि पूर्व फर्काई राखिएको छ ।मन्दिर निर्माणबारे थाहा हुने कुनै अभिलेख प्राप्त नभएको हुनाले यसको निर्माण कसले र कहिले गर्‍यो भन्ने स्पष्ट छैन । तर मन्दिरको बनावटलाई नियाल्दा यो राणाकालीन भन्न सकिन्छ । गौरीघाट सत: (PPK1707) को पुजारीका अनुसार यो मन्दिर निजीगुठी अन्तर्गत पर्दछ । दशकौदेखि बेवारिसे अवस्थामा रहेको यस मन्दिरमा केही वर्षदेखि एक सन्यासी बस्दै आइरहेको स्थानीय बताउँछन् । नजिकै रहेको नौ शिवालयको पुनर्निर्माण गरिँदा पनि यस मन्दिरको जीर्णोद्धार भएको देखिँदैन । सरोकारवालाहरू विदेशमा रहेको हुनाले मन्दिरमा नित्यपूजा र अरू कुनै धार्मिक तथा सांस्कृतिक क्रियाकलाप नभएको दशकौं भइसकेको छ (local resident, Pauḍela, male, age 45) ।
monument_assessment: Heavily damaged (collapsed, demolished, major cracks and structural damages), Surface damages, Structural damages
